title: MATH 1442: Statistics for Life Labs Modernization Project
summary: A university course-modernization project converting MATH 1442 'Statistics for Life' labs from JMP to Jamovi, R, and Python workflows, producing public-safe teaching datasets and reproducible demos. One lab notebook (Lab-08/Data_Expansion) uses SDV's CTGANSynthesizer, with a GaussianCopulaSynthesizer option, to expand a dataset into synthetic student-lab data.
needs: GaussianCopulaSynthesizer is coded behind a USE_COPULA=False toggle, so it may not actually execute in the recorded run.
